name: Check the Tune Advisor Apply
rationale:
The Tune Advisor's Save writes its suggested changes to the FC. Pins
what reaches the FC: only the advised fields change, and nothing is
written unless every read is complete (a short reply would decode as a
tune of zeros), the FC still holds the tune the flights were flown on
(same values and profiles) and the model is disarmed; a failed write is
never committed to EEPROM; advice that would leave a setting's range is
not offered; a full-stick RC Rate cut is one 20% step; P is raised at
most 50% above the pilot's own P (from changes.csv); each stage is
shown to the pilot. rfsuite issue #2808: the FC writes into whichever profile is active when each write arrives, so Apply asks MSP_STATUS for the active PID and rate profile before the reads, before each write, before the EEPROM commit and after the read-back; a switch before the first write changes nothing, a switch between writes stops before the next write and the commit, and a switch during the read-back is reported as unconfirmed. The outcome dialog opens after the page is refocused, not before: a focus call made while it is open moved focus behind it, and on a radio without a touch screen (X14) its OK could not be reached.
